b: I know this is a totally arbitrary, ridiculous and probably unanswerable question, but I have been watching a lot of stuff on the beginning of the space race and keep hearing them pronounce vacuum with the second "u" emphasized, as in this clip. By the mid 70's it seems to have already moved to the modern pronunciation. My mom says that her mother (who was born in 1910) always pronounced it that way. The Oxford English Dictionary even lists the old pronunciation as an alternate way of saying it. yet I have never heard anyone say it that way outside these old clips.
Was there a reason we stopped saying it that way?
